title: Open Farm Link spec
description: Network protocol between a Control Panel and a farm's Head Device: client at the top, entities at the bottom

blocks.title: Control Panel
blocks.description: App, cloud, HA or local hub
blocks.details:
The client side of OFL: it configures and monitors a Head Device but is never part of a real-time control loop (`docs/01-philosophy.md` §1.1, §1.3).

- Pushes configuration: Scenarios, Grow Profile, Settings.
- Reads Vitals and Vitals History by polling; there is no streaming channel.
- May write raw values through Modules, at its own risk.
- Manages many Gardens; bulk operations across them are its own concern (`docs/12-garden.md` §12.2).

Intended operating modes (see `AGENTS.md`, Product context): mobile app on the LAN, proprietary cloud, Home Assistant integration, local hub.

children.title: REST API
children.details:
Source: `docs/16-rest-api.md`

- HTTPS on port 443, JSON bodies, paths rooted at `/garden` (one Garden per device).
- Collections return summaries; sub-resources are fetched one by one to keep responses small.
- Plants are never created or deleted via the API: they appear when the hardware detects an anchor module.
- Errors: `{ "error": "…" }` with 400/401/403/404/405/409/422/429.
- **One connection at a time**; a second one is refused at TCP level, an idle one is closed after 5 s.
- Time: `GET`/`PUT /garden/time` (§16.6).

children.title: Discovery
children.details:
Source: `docs/16-rest-api.md` §16.4

- mDNS service `_ofl._tcp.local.` on port 443.
- TXT record: `garden_id`, plus `pair=button` / `pair=code` while pairing is open.
- Hostname `ofl-peer{N}.local`: the first free N on startup. N is not an identity; `garden_id` is.
- TXT data is unauthenticated: a paired device is recognised by its pinned key fingerprint.

children.title: Security
children.description: docs/22: device key, pairing, tokens and login/password, factory reset
children.details:
Source: `docs/22-security.md` (rationale in `AGENTS.md`, Security design notes)

- **No unauthenticated access**, no switch to disable it (§22.1).
- Device identity: a self-signed key pinned by the client; `garden_id` derives from it (§22.2).
- **Pairing:** a mandatory button window, or an optional 80-bit setup code with a challenge step (§22.3–22.4).
- **Credentials:** bearer tokens or login/password over HTTP Basic, all with full access (§22.5–22.6).
- Factory reset regenerates the key, so the device becomes a new Garden (§22.8).

blocks.title: Entity model
blocks.description: Garden of Plants, a System and Scenarios; transport-independent

children.title: Garden
children.details:
Sources: `docs/12-garden.md`, `docs/21-system-fields.md`, overview in `docs/02-entities-overview.md`

- Top-level entity, one per Head Device: `garden_id`, `name`, `description`, `protocol_version`, `status`, `type`.
- Holds `plants` (unordered), one `system`, `preferences`, `scenarios`, `engine_capabilities`.
- Its effective capabilities are `system.capabilities ∪ engine_capabilities`.

children.title: Identity
children.details:
Source: `docs/03-plant.md`

- `plant_id` (assigned by the Head Device), `name`, `description`, `status`.
- A Plant is the unit of control: the group of modules the Head Device assigned to one `plant_id`, exactly one of them the **anchor** (pot/slot), the rest non-anchor (light, valve…).
- How the device forms the group is outside OFL (§1.7).

children.title: Readings
children.details:
Sources: `docs/04-vitals.md`, `docs/05-vitals-history.md`

- **Vitals:** current normalized readings, keyed by the Capability Catalog.
- **Vitals History:** append-only time series; `interval` is stored per record.

children.title: Configuration
children.details:
Sources: `docs/06-hardware-calibration.md`, `docs/07-settings.md`, `docs/08-grow-profile.md`

- **Hardware Calibration:** per hardware model (`blueprint_id` + `endpoint_type`), refreshed from the library, not user-owned.
- **Settings:** per installed module (`module_id`), seeded from the library, then user-owned.
- **Grow Profile:** targets for the plant's species, imported and editable; independent of the two above.

children.title: Control
children.details:
Sources: `docs/09-modules.md`, `docs/14-capabilities.md`, `docs/17-actuators.md`

- **Modules:** raw list of the group's physical modules and endpoints; the only place hardware detail surfaces. Raw writes, at the caller's risk.
- **Capabilities:** derived binary flags (what this Plant can do); gate Scenarios, Grow Profiles and Culture Packs (`422 missing_capabilities`).
- **Actuators:** normalized read/write state of every controllable capability; Scenarios act through it.

children.title: System
children.description: docs/10: shared modules, e.g. water tank
children.details:
Source: `docs/10-system.md`

- Modules not tied to any Plant: water tank, mains pump. Exactly one System per Garden, no id.
- Same composition as Plant (vitals, history, calibration, settings, modules, capabilities, actuators) **minus Grow Profile**: there is no species to target.
- Driven by Scenarios that read across Plants ("if any Plant wants water, run the pump").

children.title: Automation
children.details:
Sources: `docs/11-scenarios.md`, `docs/13-preferences.md`, `docs/15-culture-pack.md`

- **Scenarios** run on the Head Device without the Control Panel. They read Vitals, Grow Profile, Settings and Preferences and write through Actuators, never Modules.
- Kinds: `generic` (one firmware template per category), `specialized` (bound to one target), `script` (reserved, gated by an `engine.*` capability).
- **Preferences:** garden-wide limits for Scenarios: quiet hours, brightness cap, vacation mode.
- **Culture Pack:** a Grow Profile plus specialized Scenarios, imported together from a library.

blocks.title: Principles
blocks.details:
Source: `docs/01-philosophy.md`

- **§1.1 Pure push:** the Control Panel decides; the Head Device executes.
- **§1.2 Transport is separate:** v0.1 defines only the local HTTPS binding; the entity model must carry over to future (e.g. cloud) bindings unchanged. Stateless, one request at a time.
- **§1.3 Autonomy:** watering, light and climate run on the device with no Control Panel.
- **§1.4 Desired state,** not one-off actions (except raw Modules).
- **§1.5 Zero-config:** stack the rack, scan the kit, defaults come from a library.
- **§1.6 Resources:** must fit a plain ESP32, ideally ESP32-C3.
- **§1.7 Backend-agnostic:** no bus or register concepts outside Modules.
- **§1.8 No unauthenticated access.**

blocks.title: Dictionaries
blocks.details:
Standard catalogs shared by the entities (overview in `docs/02-entities-overview.md` §2.7):

- `docs/18-module-classes.md` — module `class` values (raw layer)
- `docs/19-endpoint-types.md` — endpoint `type`/`format` values (raw layer)
- `docs/20-capability-catalog.md` — keys for Vitals, Actuators and Capabilities; `engine.*` namespace
- `docs/21-system-fields.md` — `status` and `protocol_version` on Garden and Plant

Each has an open vendor range.
